title: Coins
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

There are $X+Y+Z$ people, conveniently numbered $1$ through $X+Y+Z$. Person $i$ has $A_i$ gold coins, $B_i$ silver coins and $C_i$ bronze coins.

Snuke is thinking of getting gold coins from $X$ of those people, silver coins from $Y$ of the people and bronze coins from $Z$ of the people. It is not possible to get two or more different colors of coins from a single person. On the other hand, a person will give all of his/her coins of the color specified by Snuke.

Snuke would like to maximize the total number of coins of all colors he gets. Find the maximum possible number of coins.

## Constraints

- $1 \leq X$
- $1 \leq Y$
- $1 \leq Z$
- $X+Y+Z \leq 10^5$
- $1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9$
- $1 \leq B_i \leq 10^9$
- $1 \leq C_i \leq 10^9$

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
X Y Z
A_1 B_1 C_1
A_2 B_2 C_2
:
A_{X+Y+Z} B_{X+Y+Z} C_{X+Y+Z}
```

## Output

Print the maximum possible total number of coins of all colors he gets.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

有 $X+Y+Z$ 个人，编号为 $1$ 到 $X+Y+Z$。第 $i$ 个人有 $A_i$ 枚金币、$B_i$ 枚银币和 $C_i$ 枚铜币。

Snuke 想要从其中 $X$ 个人那里拿金币，从其中 $Y$ 个人那里拿银币，并从其中 $Z$ 个人那里拿铜币。同一个人不能拿两种或更多不同颜色的硬币。另一方面，对于 Snuke 指定的颜色，该人会把自己拥有的该颜色的所有硬币都给出来。

Snuke 想要使拿到的所有颜色硬币的总数最大。请找出可能的最大硬币总数。

## 约束条件

- $1 \leq X$
- $1 \leq Y$
- $1 \leq Z$
- $X+Y+Z \leq 10^5$
- $1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9$
- $1 \leq B_i \leq 10^9$
- $1 \leq C_i \leq 10^9$

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
X Y Z
A_1 B_1 C_1
A_2 B_2 C_2
:
A_{X+Y+Z} B_{X+Y+Z} C_{X+Y+Z}
```

## 输出格式

输出 Snuke 能拿到的所有颜色硬币总数的最大值。

samples.note: Get silver coins from Person $1$, silver coins from Person $2$, bronze coins from Person $3$ and gold coins from Person $4$. In this case, the total number of coins will be $4+2+7+5=18$. It is not possible to get $19$ or more coins, and the answer is therefore $18$.
